title: Produced-dataset index (cached.toml) — spec-v3, schema 2 (nested)
description: JSON Schema for the JSON projection of a cached.toml produced-dataset index. Parse the TOML to JSON, then validate. This validates the canonical written form, schema 2 (nested): an array of `produced` recipe tables keyed by (scope, cachetype, version), each carrying one `instances` entry per produced variation (parameter hash + the params key table). Schema 1 (a flat table per registry name with a single `hash` and no params) is still read by tools but is always rewritten as schema 2, so it is not validated here.

produced.description: One recipe per (scope, cachetype, version). Order is canonical (sorted); not significant.

recipe.description: A produced-dataset recipe, identified by (scope, cachetype, version); never by absolute path. Recipe-level ref/format/store are refreshed on register (not hash inputs).

cachetype.description: The producing function's importable name (default) or an explicit override.

scope.description: The resolved ownership partition; recorded, not declared. Empty string = the unscoped global store.

version.description: Optional recipe/code version (a path segment + part of the recipe identity when set).

ref.description: The producing module:function reference (refreshed across a refactor).

instances.description: One entry per produced variation (deduped by hash).

instance.description: A single produced variation: its parameter hash and the key table that produced it.

hash.description: Lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of the canonical-JSON key table.

params.description: The key table that produced this variation (the same table held by the config.toml sidecar). Omitted when empty.
